title: Index one after a sufficiently ramified DVR base change
statement: Let $B$ and $A$ be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with $A$ finite over $B$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. Let $n,r>0$, assume $r$ is invertible in $B$, $r\mid n$, and $\mathfrak m_BA=\mathfrak m_A^n$. Let $E/\operatorname{Frac}(B)$ be finite separable [def-pc-field-extension, def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] with the composite $B$-algebra structure. Let $C=\operatorname{integralClosure}_B(E)$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] be finite over $B$. For every prime $R$ of $C$ contracting to $\mathfrak m_B$, assume its ramification index and residue degree divide $r$. For a maximal ideal $P$ of $E\otimes_B A$, put $F=(E\otimes_B A)/P$, and give $F$ the $A$-algebra structure from the right tensor inclusion. Assume $A\to F$ is injective and $S=\operatorname{integralClosure}_A(F)$ is finite over $A$. Then every prime $Q$ of $S$ contracting to $\mathfrak m_A$ has ramification index one over $A$: the length of $S_Q/\mathfrak m_AS_Q$ over the prime localization $S_Q$ [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] is one.

source.place: Tags 0BRM (lemma-abhyankar), 09EM (normalized tensor factors), 09E7 (adic formal smoothness criterion).

proof.text: Introduce the finite normalizations and quotient field F. The quotient of the left tensor inclusion defines iE:E->F; tensor balancing proves compatibility with B->A->F. Field-map injectivity and fraction-field injectivity show B->A is injective, giving FaithfulSMul B A. Tensor-product induction and quotient surjectivity prove F is generated as an A-algebra by iE(E).

For each closed prime R of C, its index divides r, so is a unit in B and divides n. Its residue degree divides the unit r. Transfer that unit to the base prime residue field; the degree of inseparability is a residue-characteristic power dividing the total degree, so it is one. Thus the residue extension is separable. This is the fully proved private helper isSeparable_of_isUnit_finrank, using Mathlib finite separable/inseparable degrees.

Apply dvr_normalized_compositum_local_diagram with the proved tameness and generation. It supplies the chosen prime R, the DVRs U=C_R and T=S_Q, fraction-field structures, the local map U->T and all compatibility identities, together with the tame exponent and residue separability.

The contraction of Q is m_A, so A->T is local by the localization maximal-ideal contraction formula. Apply dvr_abhyankar_local_map_maximalIdeal to this local DVR diagram, using e_R dividing n, to obtain m_A T=m_T.

The private helper ramificationIdx_eq_one_of_map_maximalIdeal unfolds the length definition, substitutes Q intersect A=m_A, and uses the characterization of length-one quotients by maximal ideals. The displayed maximal-ideal equality therefore gives Q.ramificationIdx A=1.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0BRM, 09EM and 09E7; Mathlib finite inseparability degrees, localization and module-length APIs. The normalization diagram is reused from the existing proved library theorem.

lean.statement:
theorem dvr_abhyankar_normalized_factor_ramificationIdx_eq_one
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (n : ℕ) (hnpos : 0 < n) (r : ℕ) (hrpos : 0 < r) (hr : IsUnit (r : B))
    (hrn : r ∣ n)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Algebra B A] [Module.Finite B A]
    (hindex : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B A) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    (hE : FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E ∧ Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E) :
    letI : Algebra B E :=
      ((algebraMap (FractionRing B) E).comp (algebraMap B (FractionRing B))).toAlgebra
    let C := integralClosure B E
    Module.Finite B C →
    (∀ (R : Ideal C) (hR : R.IsPrime),
      letI := hR
      R.comap (algebraMap B C) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B →
        R.ramificationIdx B ∣ r ∧ R.inertiaDeg B ∣ r) →
    let D := E ⊗[B] A
    ∀ (P : Ideal D) (hP : P.IsMaximal),
    let := hP
    let F := D ⧸ P
    let alpha : A →+* F := (Ideal.Quotient.mk P).comp
      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : A →ₐ[B] D).toRingHom
    letI := alpha.toAlgebra
    Function.Injective alpha →
    let S := integralClosure A F
    Module.Finite A S →
    ∀ (Q : Ideal S) (hQ : Q.IsPrime),
    let := hQ
    Q.comap (algebraMap A S) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A →
      Q.ramificationIdx A = 1
